company.name: HyperProbe
company.shortDescription: Hyperprobe provides a runtime data layer for AI-native software, allowing developers to capture actual runtime state from running services.
company.description: HyperProbe develops software that helps engineering teams investigate and debug issues in running applications. Its platform enables developers and AI coding agents to capture runtime application state through live, non-blocking probes without requiring application redeployment. The platform collects contextual runtime data, such as variable values and execution state, to support incident investigation and root cause analysis while applying configurable data redaction for sensitive information. HyperProbe integrates with development environments and supports backend software workflows to streamline production debugging. The company provides tools that assist software teams in diagnosing production issues using runtime data rather than relying solely on application logs.
